subject: Temporary PO-deviation request & missing onboarding form
messages:
From: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@helixdata.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary PO deviation for Helix Data

Hi Vanessa,

Quick intro — I’m Claire on the vendor ops team at Helix Data. We’re onboarding to Redwood for a small pilot (monthly spend will be ~ $1k–2k) but our procurement team is conservative and requires a PO number for all suppliers. Because we’re a tiny startup and our ERPs are slow to spin up, our procurement group is asking whether Redwood can accept invoice-only billing for the first two months or grant a temporary PO exception so we don’t delay the integration.

We’ve filled out the basic vendor intake info but noticed your vendor onboarding form includes a couple of fields our finance system can’t supply immediately (tax ID formatting and an internal purchase code). Can we do this: 1) temporary exception for PO requirement for 60 days; 2) provide a signed onboarding attestation and a point-of-contact (procurement@helixdata.ai) for reconciliations; 3) agree on a maximum spend cap of $5k during the trial.

If needed I can loop in our CFO and attach an attestation. Looking to move the pilot this month.

Thanks,
Claire Zhang
Vendor Ops — Helix Data
Attachments: none (we tried uploading vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf but received an error)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary PO deviation for Helix Data

Claire — thanks for the note and welcome.

Short answer: we do allow temporary PO exceptions on a case-by-case basis but procurement will need a few pieces of evidence and there’s an approval cadence. I’ve copied Karthik from Procurement to list the required items and confirm the delegation path.

Next steps from my side:
- I’ll attach the vendor onboarding form (PDF) and the short PO-exception template that our legal/finance teams use.
- Can you confirm the primary billing contact and whether invoices will be sent to billing@helixdata.ai or to your AP system?
- Please confirm the spend cap you suggested ($5k over 60 days) and that Helix agrees to reconcile within 10 business days of invoice receipt.

If you send the attestation and fill the form we’ll fast-track procurement review.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (stub), po-exception-note.docx (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Claire Zhang <c.zhang@helixdata.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary PO deviation for Helix Data — procurement checklist

Claire — thanks for the context, and Vanessa, thanks for looping me in. I’m the procurement lead reviewing exceptions. We’re open to a short-term invoice-only path for small pilots but we need the following before I can approve a temporary PO exception: 

Required items (please provide):
1) Completed vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf with signature from an authorized Helix signatory. If your system can’t export our field format, a scanned PDF is fine.
2) Signed PO-exception-note.docx (we’ve attached a template) with: scope (pilot only), agreed spend cap ($5k), start/end date (60 days), and a reconciliation cadence.
3) Evidence of identity for the billing contact (business email + phone) and confirmation invoices will be sent to billing@helixdata.ai.
4) A primary accounting code to use for the trial (if unavailable we’ll put a placeholder and require update within 30 days).
5) If Helix is in the EU, we’d also need VAT registration — I believe you’re US-based so not required.

Risk controls we’ll apply on our side: invoice-only invoices will be routed through a temporary finance queue, payments capped at $5k total, and we’ll automatically flag for review if invoices are > $1k each. Exception approval is time-limited and will expire unless procurement confirms full vendor setup in our ERP.

Please send the signed docs and I’ll move this through. If you prefer, we can also accept a DocuSign link to speed signatures.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@helixdata.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary PO deviation for Helix Data — finance approvals

Folks — finance has reviewed the proposed controls. We will approve a one-time temporary PO-deviation with the following conditions: 

1) Approval window: 60 days from the start date noted in the signed PO-exception-note.docx.
2) Accounting: use placeholder account code 6500-TRIAL until Helix provides their internal code (must be updated within 30 days or we will pause payments).
3) Invoice routing: invoices must be sent to billing@helixdata.ai and cc: accounting@redwood.com.
4) Spend cap and per-invoice threshold: $5k overall cap; flag any invoice > $1k for manual review.
5) Escalation: if reconciliation not completed within 10 business days of invoice, payments will be suspended and Procurement will be notified.

Karthik — please record exception in SUP-4132 and add the signed on-boarding docs to vendor record. Claire — once you upload the completed vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf and the signed po-exception-note.docx I will confirm the temporary exception in the system.

Lauren Bishop
Finance Manager — Redwood Inference
